name: bucket
description: Start of the hour, UTC. Partitioning column.

name: device_id
description: Device identity, equal to its certificate common name.

name: site_id
description: Site the device was installed at when the reading was taken.

name: metric
description: Metric name from the platform catalogue, for example temperature_c.

name: avg_value
description: Sample-count weighted mean over the hour. Weighted, not a mean of means: devices publish at different cadences, so an unweighted average of the minute buckets would over-count the slow ones.

name: min_value
description: Lowest single sample in the hour.

name: max_value
description: Highest single sample in the hour.

name: sample_count
description: Raw samples behind this row. Doubles as a completeness signal: a device on a 10 second cadence should show 360.

name: exported_at
description: When the export ran. Lets a re-export be identified and deduplicated.
